best_idea: A spray emitter keeps a clock with backlog catch-up, places each droplet by its overshoot along its velocity, kills droplets memorylessly with probability dt over lifetime, and drops the oldest when a fixed cap is reached.
decision_why: The emitter shape gives the same droplet count at 30 and 60 fps and a hard cap for phones, which a blood spray needs; the donor's planet physics (gravity, wind, atmosphere, ground bounce) does not fit an arena and is dropped, and the copyleft licence means a clean-room sketch only.
acceptance: Each confirmed hit throws a short spray that thins out over about half a second; at 30 fps and at 60 fps the droplet count per second is the same within one droplet; the spray never holds more than the cap; a blocked hit throws none.
